transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I decided to come in because I've been feeling extremely unsafe and anxious lately. I have this constant feeling that I am being watched and monitored by other people, and it has been going on for a very long time now. I just don't feel safe anymore.
Besides feeling watched and unsafe, have you experienced any distinct periods where your mood was unusually elevated, energetic, or conversely, very low and hopeless for days or weeks at a time?
No, I haven't really experienced those kinds of extreme mood swings. My mood has been mostly normal, though I am constantly anxious and scared because of the people watching me.

Beyond the feeling of being watched, have you noticed any other changes in your life, such as difficulty keeping up with your daily responsibilities, hearing voices, or finding that your thoughts have become disorganized or hard to follow?

Yes, I've actually been hearing these quiet whispering voices even when I'm completely alone, and it's really terrifying. My thoughts also feel incredibly jumbled up lately, making it so hard to stay on track or even explain things clearly. It's just getting so overwhelming to keep up with anything.

latest_inference.note: The patient reports persistent persecutory delusions, auditory hallucinations, and disorganized thinking. The absence of significant mood episodes (mania or depression) makes Schizoaffective Disorder unlikely, and the duration/severity of these symptoms points strongly toward Schizophrenia rather than Delusional Disorder.
